title: fix(desktop): resolve local link paths without decoding the document folder (#4749)
issueTitle: [Bug] Malformed percent-encoded local link throws an unhandled URIError in the main process
why: On the buggy build the only symptom is an exception in the main-process terminal log, which the test cannot see, and the report allows several fixed behaviours (a notification, a create-file prompt, or silently ignoring the click), so there is no visible text that only the fixed app shows.
